subject: Discovery + calendar sync for NovaEdge inference evaluation
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novaedge.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + discovery: aligning on NovaEdge's inference needs

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the intro. I’m Monica (AE on the Redwood Inference account team); I work with Stephanie (cc’d), our solutions engineer, on technical discovery and demos. We’d love to set up a 45–60 minute discovery session to understand NovaEdge’s inference footprint, latency/cost targets, and any procurement/security checklists we should prepare for.

Proposed agenda (short):
- 15m: business goals & success metrics (you / champion)
- 20m: technical environment & constraints (engineering lead)
- 10–20m: next steps & timeline (procurement / security flags)

A few times that work on our side this week:
- Wed 2026-03-03, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-03-03, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2026-03-04, 14:00–15:00 PT

If none of these hit, tell us a couple windows that do and we’ll adjust. I’m attaching a short agenda PDF and will follow up with a calendar invite once we lock time.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: MVP-demo-agenda-v1.pdf
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novaedge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rkumar@novaedge.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@novaedge.com>, security@novaedge.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery: aligning on NovaEdge's inference needs

Hi Monica —

Thanks — happy to get this on the calendar. Short background: I’m the product champion; Rajiv (cc) is our ML platform lead and will need to drive the technical discussion. Elaine from procurement and our security alias are included for any compliance/contract questions.

Rajiv is available:
- Wed 2026-03-03, 09:30–10:30 PT (tight)
- Wed 2026-03-03, 13:30–15:00 PT (best)
- Thu 2026-03-04, 15:00–16:00 PT

Prefer the Wed afternoon slot if that works. For procurement: we’ll want an initial sense of pricing model and whether you support SOC2/audit artifacts. Security: we’ll send the security questionnaire in advance — happy to route it.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Cole
Director of Product, NovaEdge
samantha.cole@novaedge.com

Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Calendar invite + updated agenda (tentative: Wed 3/3 14:00 PT)

Hi Samantha / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on Rajiv’s note that Wed afternoon is best, I’ve tentatively booked Wed 2026-03-03, 14:00–15:00 PT and shared a calendar invite (novaedge-discovery-invite.ics). Stephanie will run the technical portion; Rachel (CS) will be available for early deployment/rollout questions.

I attached an updated agenda (v2) with a couple additional prompts for the engineering section so we can dive straight into environment, data flow, and model sizing. If security or procurement needs a separate pre-call, say so and we’ll schedule that right away.

Quick ask before the call: Rajiv, could you share a 1-paragraph bullet list of current inference stack (cloud provider, inference framework, approximate qps & p95 latency targets)? That will help Stephanie prepare the right eval examples.

Thanks — see you Wed.

— Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: novaedge-discovery-invite.ics, MVP-demo-agenda-v2.pdf
From: Rajiv Kumar <rkumar@novaedge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novaedge.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novaedge.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Calendar invite + updated agenda (tentative: Wed 3/3 14:00 PT)

Hi all —

Apologies — I have a mandatory architecture review that just landed in the Wed 2–3pm slot and I won’t be able to make 14:00 PT. Would it be possible to move to Thu 2026-03-04, 14:00–15:00 PT or Thu 2026-03-04, 15:00–16:00 PT? Elaine (procurement) is copied — if either Thu slot works for you, we’ll lock it on our end.

Also, Monica — quick Q: we’ll want a short note on compliance artifacts (SOC2 / audit logs). Do you have a one-pager or a link we can review ahead of time?

Thanks — Rajiv
ML Platform Lead, NovaEdge
